explanation: The theorem says that an element of the centralizer of z conjugates elements of leechQ z (a subgroup of G, defined by the library) back into leechQ z. It is proved from the library's own structure field φ_ker, which says membership in leechQ z is equivalent to φ being 1 on the element. The only generic Mathlib fact involved is that a kernel is normal (Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem). That does not apply directly, because leechQ z is a subgroup of G and the map φ is defined on the centralizer subtype. Using it would need the same φ_ker rewriting, which is the substance of this proof. I found no Mathlib declaration that states or one-step derives this. The library's own conj_mem_leechQ does not count.
